title: That Voice Could Be Fake — The AI Scam Check
description:
An unexpected urgent call can sound familiar without proving who is calling. A short cybersecurity awareness film about AI voice impersonation and independent verification.

Original motion graphics and synthetic English narration. Signals and networks are illustrative, not detection software.

Sources:
https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/scammers-use-fake-emergencies-steal-your-money
https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/03/scammers-use-ai-enhance-their-family-emergency-schemes

scenes.title: That voice could be fake.
scenes.image_credit: Original animated schematic by Keou. Decorative signal, not biometric evidence.
scenes.voice: Your phone rings. It sounds like someone you trust. They need money, right now. What would you do?

scenes.title: Familiar does not mean verified.
scenes.image_credit: Original illustrative network by Keou; simplified AI concept, not a model architecture.
scenes.voice: Artificial intelligence can imitate a familiar voice. Sounding convincing does not prove who is calling.

scenes.title: Urgency is part of the trap.
scenes.voice: Scammers use urgency to rush a decision. A frightening story can make an ordinary request feel impossible to question.

scenes.title: Break the pressure.
scenes.voice: Before you act, make one independent check.

scenes.title: Hang up. Then call back.
scenes.image_credit: Original verification-flow schematic by Keou. Illustrative, not live security telemetry.
scenes.voice: Hang up. Call the person back on a number you already know. Do not use contact details from the suspicious message.

scenes.title: Three moves. More control.
scenes.voice: Pause, verify, then decide. A familiar voice is a clue, not an identity check.

scenes.title: Plan before the pressure.
scenes.voice: Share this habit with your family. Agree on how you will verify an unexpected urgent request.

scenes.title: Would you trust the voice?
scenes.voice: If that call came tonight, would you trust the voice, or verify the person?
